Togetic

Fairy Flying

Johto · Generation 2

Togetic is a Fairy/Flying-type Happiness Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 3.2 kg. It evolves from Togepi and into Togekiss. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (105), with a base stat total of 405.
